title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: duplicate state assignment in C export_oscore
description: Both edhoc_initiator_export_oscore and edhoc_responder_export_oscore set ctx->state = EDHOC_STATE_EXPORTED twice on the success path (lines 1040+1049 and 1555+1564 in edhoc.c). The first assignment before the crypto_wipe block is correct; the second is redundant. While not a security bug, it is a latent defect risk if code is inserted between the two assignments. Remove the redundant second assignment.
